name: Dannosaki Jilld
source:
Second son of a vampire family.

Jilld's body is weak and sickly, so he stays indoor most of the time. Because he doesn't like disputes, he wants to coexist with humans.
He is a good, serious but unreasonable, young man who tends to conflict with family members here and there, partly due to him going through a rebellious phase.
His older brother [url=/c4980]Vlad[/url] often hits him for being a [url=/i720]hikikomori[/url]. While seeking for somebody who could understand him, he met [url=/c4988]Fuuka[/url] in the hospital.

Favorite game genres: Role-Playing, Simulation.
Favorite food: Hamburger (with cheese), corn pottage.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
